notes.title: A Brief Recap of 2023
notes.content:
[h3]Candy Guards,[/h3]

2023 has been a year of challenges and harvest for us!

This year, [i][b]Candy Disaster[/b][/i] released Snow Smash & Daily Challenge Modes, Arcade Trap pack, and the Pirate's Loot system. We also launched the sequel [i][b]Trap Master[/b][/i] in November!

As the sequel to [i]Candy Disaster[/i], [i]Trap Master[/i] takes the tower defense elements that you love in [i]Candy Disaster[/i], and adds to it rougelike deckbuilding mechanics, in order to bring you a creative, fun, and replayable gaming experience!

[h3][i]Trap Master[/i] has been released in November as Early Access. Don't miss it if you haven't tried it yet (Currently it's at historical discount!)
[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330870/CD_2_Trap_Master/

Just in time for the winter sale, Candy Disaster is 60% off ↓↓↓↓

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231460/Candy_Disaster__Tower_Defense/

Looking ahead to next year, we will release the full version of Trap Master - stay tuned!

Happy winter & stay warm,
ACE

notes.title: "Candy Disaster" version 3.0.0 update will be available on July 27th
notes.content:
[h1] "Candy Disaster" version 3.0.0 update will be available on July 27th[/h1]

[h2]1. Arcade Trap Pack[/h2]
The Arcade Traps Pack includes 3 traps:
[b]Gravity Magnet[/b]: (ground trap)
Release the force field to attract all enemies within a grid, gather the enemies and slow them down for a period of time.
[b]Suicide Attack[/b]: (replace trap)
If a unit (non-explosive soldier) dies within the range of the Suicide Attack, a self-destruct soldier will be recruited. The self-explosive soldiers will automatically find enemies within a certain range to launch a self-explosive Attack.
[b]Penalty Blade[/b]: (Wall Trap)
When one of your units dies on the field, fire a flying blade that deals damage equal to half the Health of the dead unit.
(Our units such as: Cold Swordsman and Sharp Shooter, Self-Destructive Soldiers)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/893b86f35273282b3a131ea495747beb0df6705a.png[/img]
The three traps complete and assist each other. The Gravity Magnet will ensure that the enemies will be concentrated around the Suicide Attack battalion to be killed, and the self-explosive soldiers generated by the Suicide Attack battalion will trigger the Penalty Blade to launch flying blade. Of course, their existing traps also have many linkages. For example, flying blade can also be affected by other traps to bring attributes, and the self-destruction of self-destruct soldiers can also trigger an explosion of poison gas.

[h2]2. Daily challenge mode[/h2]
The new [b]Daily Challenge mode[/b] has been updated, and the Arcade Trap can be unlocked when player clearing the daily challenge for the first time. In the daily challenge mode, players all over the world will play the game on the map, and upload their final score on the daily ranking list. Daily challenges will also have different strings and buffs, as well as banned traps. With the blessing of the buff, the enemies on the grass may also be unable to be killed by the water just like the enemies on the snow land. Of course, buffs are not all about difficulty increases. Players will also have random enhancements. The buffs and maps of the daily challenge will change daily, guaranteeing new challenges for players every day, and at the same time giving players around the world the opportunity to compete with each other and see who is the real trap master!

notes.title: Get Ready for the New "Pirate's Loot" System!
notes.content:
[b]Candy Defenders:
[/b]
It’s been a while! We have been adding lots of new content to Candy Disaster – our latest update includes a Pirate’s Loot system that drops random upgrades, 8 redesigned levels, and a collection of trading cards and community items.

[h3]During the Steam Sales (March 16th - 23rd), Candy Disaster will be [b][u]30% off[/u][/b] - Don't miss the all-time low price![/h3]

[h3]New Pirate’s Loot System Live!
[/h3]After you finish Level 2-1, the Pirate’s Loot system will be unlocked: For every four waves of enemies you kill, you will get a pirate’s chest, which presents you with [u][b]3 random upgrade choices to choose 1 from[/b][/u]. If you’ve already cleared Level 2-1, keep your eyes peeled for the chests in your next game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/cddc57d5866ce00759d0c8189d54b9f5fcdf7119.png[/img]

[h3]8 Forest Levels Redesigned![/h3]
We have re-designed Levels 1-1 to 1-8 in the Forest chapter – Each of these levels now has [u][b]new maps, adjusted difficulty, and rearranged trap-unlock rewards[/b][/u]. We hope you enjoy the new challenges! 
The old levels were moved to Level 1-10 to 1-17, expanding the Forest chapter to 17 levels in total.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/e0c475aa85f2b4a86d1f5af9d633e7b4f9fa5488.png[/img]

[h3]Trading cards Available Now![/h3]
We've also released Steam Trading Cards! Collect cards to craft your [u][b]“Candy Defender” badge[/b][/u], and unlock hilarious emoticons and space-themed profile backgrounds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/e4709ab2de20b332586aa60f9556b446fe53937b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/97e51c01171e9441559d9bc6870c275c47bd673a.png[/img]

[h3]Get the [Game + OST] Bundle for Extra 10% Off![/h3]
Jiggle-Wiggle with Jick! - Did you like the music from the first 2 chapters of the game? Or do you just want to support the developer? We’ve prepared a [Game + OST] Bundle with an [u][b]additional 10% discount[/b][/u]! If you already own the game, you will just buy the soundtracks.

We hope you enjoy the new content. If you have any feedback or suggestions, get in touch!

- Klaus

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231460]Follow on Steam[/url]
[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/gdeRqfmB4J][b]Join Discord to talk with dev[/b][/url]
